text:
deploy-bot: [deploy] Release candidate rc-2026-03-20 for inference-service blocked: env-parity-check failed between staging and prod. Missing secret key: /services/inference/REDIS_CREDENTIALS in prod. details: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rc-2026-03-20
maria: saw the alert, putting canary on hold :hand_splayed:
sam: any idea who touched redis creds? I didn't touch prod secrets last night
olivia: I rotated redis creds in staging for a test cluster and forgot to sync to prod. my bad :grimacing:
diego: don't promote the canary. if prod lacks REDIS_CREDENTIALS traffic shift will blow up the worker pool
rebecca: can we patch prod quickly? who has KMS access to wrap the new secret?
maria: I have access to the prod KMS alias `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:alias/redwood-prod-kms`. i'll patch once we agree.
sam: quick check — kubectl outputs:
```
$ kubectl -n prod get secret inference-secrets -o jsonpath='{.data}' | jq
{
  "DB_PASSWORD": "****",
  "API_KEY": "****"
}
$ kubectl -n staging get secret inference-secrets -o jsonpath='{.data}' | jq
{
  "DB_PASSWORD": "****",
  "API_KEY": "****",
  "REDIS_CREDENTIALS": "****"
}
```
olivia: yep that's the delta. staging has REDIS_CREDENTIALS, prod doesn't
diego: we should also check secret key format. last rotation used new JSON blob with fields host/port/password instead of single string. If prod gets old format it may still break
maria: i'll re-create the prod secret with the new JSON blob using KMS envelope. command:
```
kubectl -n prod create secret generic inference-secrets \
  --from-literal=DB_PASSWORD=redacted \
  --from-literal=API_KEY=redacted \
  --from-file=REDIS_CREDENTIALS=./redis_creds.json \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```
maria: patching prod now :hammer_and_wrench: 
deploy-bot: manual secret patch detected for rc-2026-03-20 by maria at 1769999105
deploy-bot: re-running env-parity-check... :mag_right:
deploy-bot: env-parity-check PASS between staging and prod for inference-service — canary hold released
olivia: I'll re-trigger canary promotion, watch logs for redis auth errors
diego: later: follow-up action item: add a pre-release secret-sync job to the release pipeline to fail early if secret keys differ :memo:
rebecca: filed ticket INFRA-4325 to add secret-sync step and document rotation SOPs
maria: noted. rolling canary now :rocket:
